vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: macro-helper
Version: 1.0.3

The macro-helper skill is a legitimate utility designed to assist users with Excel VBA development, providing code generation, debugging advice, and templates. The core logic in scripts/macro.sh simply outputs helpful text and well-structured VBA code snippets to the agent, with no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious command execution, or prompt injection attacks.

llm.summary: The skill's files and instructions match its stated purpose (Excel/VBA macro help); it contains only a helper shell script that prints/generates VBA templates and guidance and does not request credentials, perform network calls, or install software.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (Macro Helper) align with the provided artifacts: SKILL.md, tips.md, and scripts/macro.sh all focus on generating, explaining, debugging, templating, converting and optimizing VBA/Excel macros. There are no unrelated requirements (no cloud creds, no unrelated binaries).
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited: they tell the agent / user to run the included bash script with a command and task/context. The script outputs VBA snippets, explanations, and templates. It does not instruct reading arbitrary system files, environment secrets, or sending data to external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no downloads. The skill is instruction-only plus a local script (scripts/macro.sh). No archives are fetched or extracted and nothing is written to disk by an installer.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not declare or use any environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The included templates reference Excel/Outlook automation (which is expected for a macro helper) but do not request external secrets or tokens.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Flags: always is false; the skill does not request persistent/system-wide privileges or modify other skills. It is user-invocable and can be invoked autonomously (platform default) but there are no additional persistent privileges requested by the skill.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk as distributed: it provides VBA code and guidance only. However, VBA macros themselves can perform powerful actions (read/write files, automate Outlook to send email, delete data, etc.). Before running generated macros: review the code line-by-line, run them in a sandbox or on a copy of your workbook, prefer .Display over .Send when automating email, check any file paths/Dir/Workbooks.Open use, and ensure macro security settings are appropriate. If you need higher assurance, test generated macros in a virtual machine or isolated environment and do not enable macros in untrusted workbooks.
